materials.item: The Economy 2.0: Microeconomics (CORE Econ), free online
Research papers and readings shared via Canvas

LER 440.attendance: I-Clicker points require attending class; using the I-Clicker from outside the classroom loses all I-Clicker points. Lecture attendance is strongly advised.
LER 440.lateWork: Submit on Canvas within 5 minutes of class start on the due date. Late work gets half credit if in before the start of the next class.
LER 440.makeups: No make-up exams and none for I-Clicker questions. If you miss an exam without contacting the instructor before it starts, the score is zero; with documented emergency, replacement work is discussed.
other: Tell the instructor by the end of week 2 about any exam date conflict.
Each reading assignment is a 250-300 word summary plus three questions.
Four-credit students must discuss extra expectations in the first week.
Total of 1000 points is the sum of the listed items.

grading.drop: Lowest 2 of 7 readings and lowest 1 of 5 problem sets are dropped

LER 440.finalExam: Date listed as TBD; if you need a conflict exam, the obligation falls on the larger of the two lecture sections
LER 440.lateWork: Assignments must be uploaded by the start of class on the due date; late work is not accepted
LER 440.makeups: No makeup exams. If an emergency makes you miss one, contact the instructor before it starts or get 0; documentation required, and extra work may replace it.
other: Tell the instructor by the end of week two about any conflict with an exam date
Each reading is a 2-3 paragraph summary plus at least 3 questions
Graduate students handle 3 extra chapters and extra problem set exercises
